title: Project filler file — the envelope a data point's filler answers in
description: A backbone file schema (ADR-056) for the envelope of a filler: the project's own filler file, found by its location — `<internal-root>/pkit/fillers/<publisher>/<role>/<point>.yaml` for the point `<publisher>::<role>:<point>` (the lifecycle README, "Where a project filler file lives") — and the one JSON document a capability's command filler prints (COR-052 points 2 and 6). The envelope is the backbone's; the value inside it is the point's, validated by the companion schema of the point's active provider and never by this one. Strict: an unknown key is an error carrying the nearest known key. `remove` is the project's alone: a command filler's answer carries only `schema_version` and `value`. The editor directive (`# yaml-language-server: $schema=...`) is a comment, not a key.

schema_version.description: The version of the point this filler targets — the companion integer of the point (COR-052 point 5). It must equal the point's version: a project file at another version is a validation error, and its value is not read.

value.description: The point's value, in the point's own shape. For a `union` or an `additive` point it is a list of entries, each a string — its own id — or a mapping carrying a string `id`; ids are unique within one filler.

remove.description: Removal overrides, each with its reason (COR-052 points 2 to 4): entries of the other fillers — capabilities and the default — that the point drops, by id. In a `union` point this is a suppression; in an `additive` point it is the only way an entry leaves. A `single` point takes none.

id.description: The id of the entry to drop.

reason.description: Why it is dropped — required, and shown wherever the resolution is.
